title: HB1119 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, creates a Class A misdemeanor of possessing a firearm if a person has a prior conviction of stalking. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2019-02-06; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 1894499)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2019-02-06, shared with twin SB 1415. Adds a new subdivision to 39-17-1307(f)(1); applies to violations on or after July 1, 2019.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(f)(1)): ( ) Has been convicted of the offense of stalking under § 39-17-315, or of an offense committed in another state, territory, or under federal law, that would constitute the offense of stalking under § 39-17-315, if committed in this state.
